How it works

Talk at the speed you think. Your editor keeps up.

Say it how you’d say it

Ramble, pause, correct yourself mid-sentence. Rollcall hears timestamps, clip names and rough directions, and understands what you meant.

It becomes an edit plan

Fillers and repeats go. What’s left is a short list of concrete edits at real timecodes, checked against your open project before anything moves.

Applied inside your editor

Each edit runs through the editor’s own scripting layer, so it lands as a normal, undoable change in DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or CapCut.

Built for the editors people already use.

Rollcall drives each editor through its own scripting interface. Nothing is re-rendered or exported behind your back.

  • DaVinci Resolve
  • CapCut Pro
  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Final Cut Pro next
  • After Effects next
  • Descript next

Missing yours? Tell us on the waitlist form. Editor support is prioritised by requests.

Things you can just say.

No fixed phrases to memorise. These are real examples from testing.

Cutting and timing

  • Cut here and delete the pause before it.
  • Trim the last two seconds off this clip.
  • Move the B-roll to start at 0:38.
  • Speed up everything between 1:10 and 1:30 by 1.5x.

Text and captions

  • Add a lower third with my name, white on dark.
  • Auto-caption this section in the yellow style I used earlier.
  • Make that title bigger and move it up a bit.
  • Change every caption to the brand font.

Colour and look

  • Warm this shot up slightly.
  • Match the colour of this clip to the previous one.
  • Apply the LUT from the intro to the whole V1 track.
  • Add a soft vignette from 0:20 to 0:45.

Audio

  • Duck the music under the voiceover.
  • Mute the music from 0:14 until the next cut.
  • Remove background noise on A1.
  • Fade the last clip out over two seconds.

Faster than the menu you're looking for.

Most edits are a handful of clicks you've done a thousand times. Saying them is quicker than finding them, and it works with your hands off the mouse.

By hand
~48s
With Rollcall
~7s

Adding a styled caption at a timestamp, measured on internal testing. Your numbers will vary.

Your footage stays on your Mac.

Rollcall reads project structure, not media. Speech is transcribed on-device, and only the text of your command and the timeline metadata it needs are sent to the model.

  • No video or audio files uploaded
  • Every action is a normal undo step
  • Push-to-talk by default; nothing records in the background
